{"code":"import Mathlib

example (n : ℕ) (h : IsField (ZMod n)) : Nat.Prime n := by
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · simp [hn0] at h
  · by_cases hn1 : n = 1
    · simp [hn1] at h
    · have hnp : NeZero n := ⟨hn0⟩
      let p := Nat.minFac n
      have hp : Nat.Prime p := Nat.minFac_prime hn1
      have hpdvd : p ∣ n := Nat.minFac_dvd n
      have hunit : IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := by
        -- from field every nonzero is unit
        have hz : (p : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at hz
          have hle := Nat.minFac_le n
          sorry
        exact h.1 (p : ZMod n) hz
      have hnotunit : ¬ IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := by
        exact (ZMod.isUnit_prime_iff_not_dvd hp).2 ?_
      exact hp
"}

{"code":"import Mathlib

example (n : ℕ) (h : IsField (ZMod n)) : Nat.Prime n := by
  classical
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · exfalso
    have h01 : (0 : ZMod 0) = 1 := by
      simp
    exact zero_ne_one h01
  · by_cases hn1 : n = 1
    · exfalso
      have h01 : (0 : ZMod 1) = 1 := by simp
      exact zero_ne_one h01
    · let p := Nat.minFac n
      have hp : Nat.Prime p := Nat.minFac_prime hn1
      have hpdvd : p ∣ n := Nat.minFac_dvd n
      have hnonzero : (p : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at hz
        have hnp1 : n ≤ p := hz
        have hple : p ≤ n := Nat.minFac_le_of_dvd ?_ hpdvd
        · have hEq : n = p := Nat.le_antisymm hnp1 hple
          have hdiv1 : n ∣ 1 := by
            rw [hEq]
            exact hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow ?_ 
          exact hn1 (Nat.dvd_one.mp hdiv1)
        · exact hp.ne_one
      have hunit : IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := (isUnit_iff_ne_zero).2 hnonzero
      have hnotdvd : ¬ p ∣ n := (ZMod.isUnit_prime_iff_not_dvd hp).1 hunit
      exact False.elim (hnotdvd hpdvd)
"}
